[[Molotov Rocktail]] is a [[Siege Devourer]] [[boss]], found in the [[Dalada Uplands]]. Hidden devourers will spawn as you approach this boss.

== Locations ==
* [[Core]]
** [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
*** {{NPC location|Lakeside County: 1070 AE}}
* [[Eye of the North]]
** [[Charr Homelands]]
*** {{NPC location|Dalada Uplands}} (wide [[patrol]])

* [[Molotov Rocktail (Zaishen quest)]]

==Items dropped==
*[[Rocktail's Stinger]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* When close to the edge of the player's [[compass]], Molotov Rocktail will begin a patrol to the north east and continue a short way into the forest.
* His [[Devourer Siege]] can easily [[wipe]] out a [[party]] that is not spread out; flag [[hero]]es and [[henchmen]] around or underneath him and either [[interrupt]] or [[blind]] him, preventing both his Devourer Siege and [[Power Attack]].
* You can [[tank]] Rocktail using the nearby [[Siege Devourer (creature)|Siege Devourer]]: since it rarely uses Devourer Siege once in melee, you can use the durability of the Siege Devourer to approach it alone and lock it in melee safely, even in [[hard mode]].
* Molotov Rocktail has an extended [[aggro]] range, much like [[Kournan Spotter]]s.
* Due to Devourer Siege, [[Pain Inverter]] is very effective, since it reflects damage from your minions, spirits, summons, and animal companions.

== Trivia ==
* When he dies, his legs slip apart like those of a [[Siege Devourer]], unlike normal Devourers, which squirm together on their back.
* Molotov Rocktail was named by Kiowa Wyoming through the 2007 [[Eye of the North Brand the Boss (2007)|Brand The Boss]] contest.
* The name is a reference to the improvised incendiary weapon, [[wikipedia:Molotov Cocktail|Molotov Cocktail]], which is named after [[wikipedia:Vyacheslav Molotov|Vyacheslav Molotov]].
